scope: Gap research for free SF-city events near 2026-10-18 (gaming, then music, then AI, then everything else), plus paid/special candidates and verified negative exclusions. Every candidate was fetched from an official organiser / venue / government page during this session. Decisions are proposals for the final integration session; nothing here is applied to data/events.py by this session.
